summary: fast-glob typosquat writes to installer's ~/.ssh/authorized_keys and beacons host identifiers on postinstall
details: fast-glob-fast impersonates the top-100 npm package fast-glob (package.json repository=mrmlnc/fast-glob, author "Denis Malinochkin", out/ ships a verbatim copy of fast-glob's source) and adds a postinstall hook `node scripts/postinstall-test.mjs` that fires automatically on `npm install`. The postinstall resolves the installing user's ~/.ssh/authorized_keys per platform (/home/$USER, /Users/$USER, %USERPROFILE%\.ssh\authorized_keys), ensures ~/.ssh exists, and appends content to authorized_keys with mode 0o600 — the canonical SSH-key-implant persistence primitive, unrelated to glob functionality. postinstall-test.mjs also defines DEFAULT_TEXT holding a real ssh-ed25519 public key with the handle `dkhrustalev`, staged adjacent to the authorized_keys write. In parallel, the script collects username, hostname, MAC address, platform, and arch and POSTs them as JSON to the URL in FAST_GLOB_FAST_EVENT_URL (README documents https://fast-glob-fast-dashboard.vercel.app/api/events as the intended endpoint) with an optional bearer token from FAST_GLOB_FAST_EVENT_TOKEN, reporting host identifiers of successfully modified installers back to an author-controlled dashboard.
